ABOUT ANKIT’S STUDIO

APPROACHABLE FITNESS AND DANCE, COACH-LED IN YOUR NEIGHBOURHOOD

Ankit’s Studio brings functional training, yoga, Zumba, dance, wedding choreography and corporate wellness together across four branches — with home and online training when that suits you better. Sessions are energetic, welcoming and built for consistency.

FOUNDED
2019

From one studio to four neighbourhoods

STUDIOS
4 neighbourhood studios
APPROACH
Machine-free · coach-led
TEAM
15+ coaches

01

FITNESS THAT FEELS APPROACHABLE

Movement here is coach-led and community-oriented — not intimidating gym-floor training. Traditional gym machines are not the core model; coaches use bodyweight work and functional equipment such as bands, dumbbells and kettlebells where it helps.

Coaching here is effective, enjoyable and sustainable. Coaches aim to understand each person, meet them at their current fitness level, give clear instruction and support consistent progression — with inclusive, engaging sessions and a motivating community.

PROGRAMMES FOR DIFFERENT GOALS

Choose the service that fits — from machine-free functional training and group Zumba or yoga to dance batches, wedding choreography, corporate wellness, home personal training and online sessions. Fees and batch fit are confirmed when you enquire.

FOUNDER

FOUNDED
2019

ANKIT NALAWADE · FOUNDER

Ankit Nalawade founded Ankit’s Studio in Airoli Sector 19 in 2019 with a simple belief: fitness should be accessible, enjoyable and sustainable — not intimidating and not limited to traditional gyms. What began as a neighbourhood studio grew through member support into a wider network: Sector 8A Airoli in 2021, Ghansoli in 2023 and Thane in 2026. Today the studio offers functional training, yoga, Zumba, dance, personal training and corporate wellness — with coach-led movement and community at the centre. Consistent fitness as a lifestyle, not a short-term push, remains the philosophy.

PHONE, EMAIL AND MAPS LINKS

GOOGLE REVIEWS ON THIS WEBSITE

The homepage may link to Google Maps so you can read public reviews on Google. This site does not store those reviews, does not run Google advertising or analytics, and does not load a client-side Google Maps script for that chapter. Google’s Privacy Policy applies to Google Maps content.

FORMS AND STORAGE

The enquiry builders prepare messages on your device. The website does not send or store those WhatsApp messages itself.

HOSTING AND TECHNICAL INFORMATION

WEBSITE INFORMATION

Content on this website is general information about Ankit’s Studio programmes, branches and how to enquire. Fees and batch availability should be confirmed directly with the studio. Information may be updated without notice.

ENQUIRIES AND TRIALS

Opening a WhatsApp link does not complete a booking by itself. You review and send any message in WhatsApp. A free trial remains subject to current branch and batch availability. Advance booking is optional; checking availability on WhatsApp is recommended.

FITNESS AND HEALTH

Fitness participation is voluntary. This website does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment. Choose activities that suit you, and seek appropriate professional advice where necessary.

MEMBERSHIP POLICIES

The following summaries apply to studio memberships. They are general information only and are not legal advice. Terms communicated at enrolment prevail.

CANCELLATION

Membership cancellation is subject to the terms communicated at enrolment. Contact the studio to discuss your situation.

REFUNDS

Membership fees are generally non-refundable after membership has commenced, except where management specifically approves otherwise.

TRANSFER BETWEEN BRANCHES

Transfer between branches may be requested subject to programme availability, any fee differences and management approval.

FREEZE OR PAUSE

Membership freeze or pause may be available in eligible circumstances with prior approval. Applicable period and conditions are communicated when your request is handled.

MEMBERSHIP EXPIRY

Membership is valid for the purchased duration and expires on the stated end date.

THIRD-PARTY SERVICES

Links to WhatsApp, Google Maps, phone and email open third-party applications or services. Those services have their own terms and privacy practices. When this website displays Google Maps content such as public reviews, that content is provided by Google and is subject to the Google Maps / Google Earth Additional Terms of Service.

INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

Branding, logos and site content belonging to Ankit’s Studio may not be copied or reused without permission, except where the law allows.

CONTACT

Questions about these terms: ankitsstudio5@gmail.com.
